prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency in Maryland — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and the services you need. I can help find the best fit for you faster if you tell me a few details, but here’s a short, practical guide to help you now.

Questions I need to recommend specific agencies
- What services do you need? (SEO, paid ads, social media, content, PR, branding, full-service, B2B demand gen, etc.)
- What’s your industry? (Healthcare, tech, professional services, retail, nonprofit, etc.)
- Company size and marketing budget (monthly/annual)?
- Do you prefer a local agency (Baltimore/Annapolis/Washington suburbs) or is remote OK?
- Any timeline or KPIs (lead volume, revenue, awareness)?

How to pick the best agency in Maryland (quick checklist)
- Relevant experience: ask for case studies in your industry and for similar-sized clients.
- Measurable results: insist on KPIs (CAC, LTV, ROAS, leads/month) and see past performance.
- Team fit: review who will work on your account and their availability.
- Transparency & reporting: regular, clear reporting; agreed metrics and checkpoints.
- References: call 2–3 current/former clients.
- Contract terms: look for clear scope, exit clauses, and minimum commitment period.
- Pricing model: retainer, project-based, or performance-based — choose what matches your risk tolerance.

Where to find and vet Maryland agencies
- Directories: Clutch.co, UpCity, Expertise — filter by Maryland and read client reviews.
- Local sources: Baltimore Business Journal agency lists, Maryland Tech Council, LinkedIn.
- Search: “marketing agency [service] Baltimore” + read Google reviews and case studies.

Sample questions to ask an agency
- Have you worked with companies like ours? Can you share results?
- What would the first 90 days look like?
- Who will be on our account and how often will we meet?
- What KPIs do you recommend and how do you report them?
- What is your pricing and minimum commitment?

If you want, I can:
- Recommend 5 Maryland agencies tailored to your needs (tell me the details above), or
- Pull top-rated MD agencies from Clutch/UpCity and summarize their strengths.

Which would you prefer?
